form.label: Scratch Project ID
form.hint: You can find the project ID in the Scratch project URL: scratch.mit.edu/projects/[PROJECT_ID]

infoPanel.title: How to get your Scratch Project ID:
infoPanel.step1: Open your Scratch project on scratch.mit.edu
infoPanel.step2: Look at the URL in your browser address bar
infoPanel.step3: Copy the numbers after "/projects/" - that's your project ID
infoPanel.step4: Paste the ID in the field above
